newsitem.title: UK: Alliance float to give 1,000 stg to savers -paper.
newsitem.headline: Alliance float to give 1,000 stg to savers -paper.

text.p: Savers with the Alliance and Leicester building society will get a standard allocation of 250 shares worth around 1,000 stg under flotation plans due next year, the Financial Times said on Monday.

Details of the conversion from a building society to a listed company will be sent to the 3.2 million borrowers and savers on Monday. Alliance and Leicester hopes to float by next summer, the newspaper said. It is one of three major societies due to convert its status.
To qualify for the shares, the society's savers will need to have opened their account before December 31, 1995.
They will also need to have had a balance of at least 100 stg on October 14.
The flat-rate allocation of shares will be regardless of the balance held in accounts above the stipulated level.
Advisers to the society J P Morgan estimate the company will be worth 2.8 billion stg, putting a price of around four stg on each share, the Financial Times said.
